shots.action: Monsoon rain. A cave mouth in a cliff, water streaming down the path into it; five bicycles stand at a rail in front. The last three of the team walk into the dark with a torch as lightning flashes
shots.camera: Wide and low from beside the bicycles, creeping in

shots.action: From inside the cave: boys in football shirts and their coach walk down into the dark towards us, torches on, the grey rain behind them
shots.camera: Inside the mouth, looking out, drifting back

shots.action: The bicycles in the rain, one wheel still turning. Rook stands on the rail with his arms crossed and turns his head to the cave
shots.camera: Close and low, sliding along the rail

shots.action: Brown water pours in over the lip of the cave and down the slope past the lens
shots.camera: Inside, at floor level, looking out

shots.action: A passage: the low arch they came in through goes under, the water climbs to its roof, and three boys run from it with their torches
shots.camera: Low, backing away in front of them

shots.action: Rook stands on a boulder in the flooded passage, the water racing past below him, shakes the wet off and folds his arms
Close: water runs off his hat brim. He taps his beak, unimpressed
Five of them wade waist-deep along the passage, foam piling up behind; the coach turns and waves the others on
shots.camera: From the side, tracking with them

shots.action: A slope of mud rises out of black water. Boys claw their way up it on hands and knees; the coach, last out, pushes from below. Rook hops up beside them, flapping
The whole chamber: thirteen small figures sit huddled on the mud above the water, two torches between them, the roof hung with stone
shots.camera: Wide from out over the water, rising

shots.action: Close along the front row: tired faces, knees drawn up, a torch flickering. Rook sits at the end of the row, hugging his knees, and looks along at them
A boy's hand holds the torch. It flickers, dims and goes out
A flooded tunnel: a diver drags himself along a guide line against the current, silt and bubbles streaming past him
shots.camera: In front of him, low, rolling

shots.action: A card: nine marks scratched on wet rock, one after another, a small moon under each
Over the boys' heads from the top of the slope: the black water below begins to glow. Heads lift. Rook gets to his feet
A diver's helmet breaks the surface in a ring of ripples, lamps blazing; a second comes up behind him. He raises a hand
The diver's light falls on the boys: hands up against the glare, then they are on their feet, arms in the air
Rook walks along the front row counting them off with a wingtip, a number ticking up beside him. He reaches the coach: thirteen. His hat jumps
shots.camera: Tracking with him along the row

shots.action: The diver, chest-deep at the edge, points back the way he came: the guide line runs down into the black water. The coach kneels at the edge, listening
Under the surface: a rock tunnel full of murky water, the guide line running away into it towards a narrow gap
shots.camera: Moving forward along the line, rolling

shots.action: A card: a drawn cross-section of a mountain. The mouth on the left, thirteen dots on a ledge on the right, and the tunnel between them filling with water
A small boy at the water's edge puts one foot in and pulls it straight back, arms wrapped round himself. Beside him Rook lowers a weighted line into the water to sound it
The line keeps going. Rook looks up from it, his hat jumps and a feather comes loose
A dim passage, ankle-deep. A diver wades along the guide line with an air tank in his arms, his lamp sweeping the wall
shots.camera: In front of him, backing away

shots.action: He kneels and stands the tank beside the guide line, next to three others, then looks back over his shoulder. His lamp slowly dims; water drips from the roof
shots.camera: Moving round and down towards him

shots.action: The row of tanks, one small light left flickering beside them. Rook walks up, takes his hat off, holds it to his chest and bows his head; drips ring the water
On the ledge a boy in a wetsuit lies on a silver blanket. A diver kneels over him, a hand on his arm, the coach on the other side. The boy's eyes close
shots.camera: Over the diver's shoulder, moving in

shots.action: Two gloved hands lower a full-face mask onto the sleeping boy's face
A diver stands in the water with the masked boy floating face down beside him, and takes him under. The coach watches from the edge, hands clasped; Rook stands by with a wing at his beak
Under water: the diver swims along the guide line with the limp boy held under his chest, his lamp cutting the murk, bubbles rising from both
shots.camera: From the side and ahead, rolling

shots.action: The narrow gap, from the far side: light in the slot, then the boy's masked face comes through first, eased ahead by the diver behind him
Dusk at the cave mouth under work lights, hoses running into the dark: two rescuers carry a stretcher out with a small shape under a foil blanket. Rook flaps along beside them
shots.camera: Low, backing away in front of them

shots.action: A card: thirteen small figures, twelve boys and their coach, ticked off one after another. 13 OF 13
A pump by the cave mouth shudders and puffs, then stops dead. Rook, beside it, unfolds his arms and prods it
Inside: the water comes back up the passage, over the tanks and the line. A work light on a stand topples, flickers and goes out. Rook flaps up out of the way
Morning, the rain gone. Rook stands in front of the cave mouth, turns to us and shrugs
Rook's case board, a slab of wet limestone: a photograph of the thirteen on the ledge, THIRTEEN IN, THIRTEEN OUT, stamped TRUE
By the path he picks a small brass torch out of the mud, clicks it on, pockets it and pulls his hat brim down
Back to the first picture: the cave mouth in the rain, the bicycles at the rail, the last of the team walking in; lightning
shots.camera: The opening framing, played back to its first frame
